question: Impact of delegation availability on quality, elapsed time, tokens and rework for three bounded Odoo tasks

treatments.D: Same inputs plus permission for at most two useful children; zero allowed; no nested delegation

scope: Role/execution benchmark, not end-to-end production workflow certification. Independent common posthoc reception excluded equally from run timing.
model_effort: Inherited without override; native observed gpt-6-astra/high, checked for every tree
transport: Actual Codex collaboration; serial participant trees; four slots root+parent+2children. No background audits/runtime jobs during measured runs.
inputs: Public packages identical within pair except absolute paths and S/D condition; same common PM communication instruction before freeze. Runtime clones same semantic hash and immutable images.
judging: Original outputs frozen after native completion; shared independent quality audit with opaque labels, technical verification separate; masking cooperative not cryptographically complete. No feedback or policy change within six primary runs.
quality: All mandatory case obligations and no critical issue; qualitative score10 (business4,coverage2,evidence2,useful synthesis2), threshold8. PM usability separately 0/1/2 per applicable criterion. No question fabricated to satisfy usability.
decision: Descriptive only: keep optional delegation unless D all acceptable without score/coverage loss, E02 useful child overlap and >=20% time gain and token ratio<=1.5, E01 no >25% needless-delegation penalty. One pair per case cannot establish general causal gain. If no children observed, no claim about actual delegation effect.
heldout: E03 not used to adjust policy before its pair; all policies frozen before first primary run. After observed, E03 is no longer held out for future revisions.
privacy: Export native metadata, tools/results and final only; never incoming/system/developer/reasoning messages. Encrypted native message parameters limit exposure certification.
feedback: User PM-language preference recorded verbatim in campaign JOURNAL; applied equally to S/D. No canonical role change during comparison.
preparation_incidents: Designer followup for metrics refused with agent thread limit reached; root implemented metrics locally; no candidate affected.
